headline: Ghana Chamber of Commerce Highlights Regional Inflation Divergence
summary: Ghana National Chamber of Commerce CEO reported that several administrative regions are experiencing inflation rates significantly above the national baseline, despite broad national price index moderation.
why: Regional inflation disparities impact consumer real purchasing power and supply distribution across West Africa.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Persistent regional price variances affect business operational costs in outlying areas.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
